info.title: Capy API
info.description: Programmatic access to Capy's agent platform.

allOf.description: Five-field cron expression, e.g. `0 9 * * *` for daily at 09:00.
IANA timezone for the schedule, e.g. `America/New_York`.

event.description: The GitHub event that starts a run.

repositories.description: Full repository names to match, e.g. owner/repo.

authors.description: GitHub login names of the author to match.

labels.description: Match when any of these labels is present.

actions.description: Raw event action names to match, e.g. opened, closed.

conclusions.description: Check or workflow conclusions to match, e.g. success, failure.

review_states.description: Review states to match, e.g. approved, changes_requested.

actors.description: GitHub login names of the actor that fired the event.

conditions.description: Filters that narrow which GitHub events start a run. A condition matches when the event matches any of its listed values.

allOf.description: Natural-language gate checked against each event before a run starts; non-matching events are skipped, so keep it to one sentence. To remove the gate, omit this field from the trigger; null is rejected.

event.description: The Slack event that starts a run.

workspaces.description: Slack team ids (T...) to match. Not workspace names.

channels.description: Slack channel ids (C...) to match. Not #channel-names.

users.description: Slack user ids (U...) of the message author to match.

actors.description: Slack user ids (U...) of the actor that fired the event.

reactions.description: Emoji names without colons, e.g. eyes.

message_placements.description: Match top-level messages, replies, or both.

message_types.description: Match human messages, bot messages, or both.

include_bots.description: Include messages from bots. Defaults to false.

allOf.description: Seconds to group a burst of messages into one run. Defaults to 10.

contains.description: Run only when the message text contains one of these substrings.

excludes.description: Skip when the message text contains one of these substrings.

regex.description: Run only when the message text matches this regular expression.

conditions.description: Filters that narrow which Slack events start a run. A condition matches when the event matches any of its listed values.

allOf.description: Natural-language gate checked against each event before a run starts; non-matching events are skipped, so keep it to one sentence. To remove the gate, omit this field from the trigger; null is rejected.

event.description: The Sentry event that starts a run.

projects.description: Sentry project slugs or ids to match.

levels.description: Issue levels to match, e.g. error, warning.

actions.description: Raw event action names to match.

conditions.description: Filters that narrow which Sentry events start a run. A condition matches when the event matches any of its listed values.

allOf.description: Natural-language gate checked against each event before a run starts; non-matching events are skipped, so keep it to one sentence. To remove the gate, omit this field from the trigger; null is rejected.

event.description: The Linear event that starts a run.

teams.description: Linear team ids or keys to match.

statuses.description: Issue statuses to match after the change.

from_statuses.description: Issue statuses to match before the change.

status_transitions.description: Status transitions to match, e.g. Todo->In Progress.

actors.description: Linear user ids of the actor that fired the event.

labels.description: Match when any of these labels is present.

assignees.description: Linear user ids of the assignee to match.

conditions.description: Filters that narrow which Linear events start a run. A condition matches when the event matches any of its listed values.

allOf.description: Natural-language gate checked against each event before a run starts; non-matching events are skipped, so keep it to one sentence. To remove the gate, omit this field from the trigger; null is rejected.

contains.description: Run only when the request body contains one of these substrings.

excludes.description: Skip when the request body contains one of these substrings.

regex.description: Run only when the request body matches this regular expression.

conditions.description: Filters that narrow which incoming requests start a run. A condition matches when the request matches any of its listed values.

allOf.description: Natural-language gate checked against each event before a run starts; non-matching events are skipped, so keep it to one sentence. To remove the gate, omit this field from the trigger; null is rejected.

model.description: The pinned model, or null when the automation is unpinned and each run resolves the run-as principal's default model at run creation.

enabled_server_keys.description: External MCP server keys to enable for this automation's runs, beyond the project defaults. A key may not appear in both lists.

disabled_server_keys.description: External MCP server keys to disable for this automation's runs.
